text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: A nice breeze blows through here, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text: The wind brushing against our cheeks right now will cross the sea without ever stopping.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
As this wind circles dozens, hundreds of times over,
perhaps it'll cross paths with us again in America, where we'll fight.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
By then, everyone on the team will surely have grown
beyond recognition compared to now.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
That is by no means wishful thinking.
If it's you and the girls, Trainer,
I'm certain you can make it happen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems Casino Drive's estimation has risen even further!
